messages:
jen: Heads up — planning to enable lyra-15b-v3 in the model catalog during the 2-hour change window starting 15:00 UTC today. Canary: 3% global for 30m, then 10% if metrics look good. This is text-gen only; embeddings unaffected. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/release/lyra-v3 (short summary in-line).

deploy-bot: Change window scheduled for 2026-03-20 15:00 UTC. Canary job created: canary-job-lyra-v3. I will post status updates and smoke results here.

sam: quick question — are we changing fallback ordering for catalog entries? If v3 has errors, what gets traffic?

jen: fallback stays v2 then orbit-13b-quant. We'll add a temporary circuit-breaker that flips to v2 if error spikes or sustained latency increases. Also pin critical enterprise customers to v2 for the first 24h.

lauren: proposed rollback criteria: p95 latency > +30% vs baseline for 10m OR error-rate > 1.5x baseline for 5m OR regression on the canary eval set (prompt suite A) detected. If any trigger fires, manual rollback by oncall + deploy-bot. Also recommend keeping KV cache warm for v2 during the canary.

mathieu: add kv-cache-hit% to the watchlist. If hit% drops >10 points during canary that could indicate routing or tokenization mismatch.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 15:03 UTC. Traffic = 3% global across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Smoke checks running: latency, errors, cpu/gpu util, kv-cache hit, and canary-eval. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/lyra-v3-canary

sam: routing patch (applied to canary config):
```
routing:
  model_priority:
    - lyra-15b-v3
    - lyra-15b-v2
    - orbit-13b-quant
  canary:
    percent: 3
    regions: ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"]
```

jen: pinned enterprise tenants acme and betacorp to lyra-15b-v2 for 24h so their traffic is excluded from canary: 
`pin: acme: lyra-15b-v2@2026-03-20T14:50Z` and similar for betacorp.

kai: I'll monitor alerts and be ready to trigger rollback. Rollback plan: flip catalog priority back to v2, drain v3 hosts, revoke canary route, and mark incident if customer impact. Notify #incidents and #eng-oncall on any manual rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary health update @15:35 UTC — no error spike, p50/p95 within threshold, kv-cache hit steady. Promoting to 10% at 15:40 UTC. Continuing monitor for 30m.

lauren: Updated release notes with tokenizer nuance and small prompt tweak for v3. Also added eval-suite A results to the page. :white_check_mark:

sam: on watch for 30m. Ping me if p95 climbs or any unexplained error patterns show up. :eyes:
